title: Every line's menu offers Mark as No Charge between Edit line and Delete line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 of 2.0 hours and line 2 of 1.5 hours with one stock part costing $40.00, both at the customer's labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Edit line", "Mark as No Charge" and "Delete line", in that order.
  • The menu offers no way to move the line to a separate work order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R1: “On a billable work order, while the setting is on and the work order is not invoiced, the three-dots menu of every line offers "Mark as No Charge" between Edit line and Delete line. Edit Line and New Line show at the bottom, under a divider, the checkbox "No Charge" with the helper "This line shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours and parts stay; the parts cost posts to the category's expense account." and, when ticked, the selects Category *, Original work order and Original line of S2-R2, so a line can be created No Charge. Both doors write the same fields. Lines the Line Builder creates (it has no dialog) are marked afterwards from the line menu.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Moving a line to a separate work order from the line menu. A shop that wants free work on its own work order splits the work order as today and converts the new one.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "06 Edit Line · No Charge in the dialog" (page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order"), "01 Line menu · Mark as No Charge" (page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order"), "30 Line menu · Mark as No Charge" (page "Happy flow v6"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
